text.tspan: Reported only: configurable lens sets + aperture masks → parallel multiphoton writing.
Lens pair expands the live ray bundle.
Mask clips which lenslets receive light.
Each illuminated lenslet has its own axis.
Four traced beamlets meet the resin at once.
2D paraxial section only — no 2D focus lattice, diffraction/PSF, dose, threshold curing,
calibrated per-focus power, or 3D assembly proof.
Laser emission off: no writing trace
